description:
With fz-sc8.140 the distiller's compile ends "exceeded fact-wait budget" at ~51,000 jobs (~110 s CPU); with PRODUCT_DRIVE_BUDGET raised to 2,000,000 it was still compiling after 566 s CPU. Tightening Map specs changes nothing.

Anatomy of a 54,594-completion trace (develop + fz-sc8.140; extraction cached in the fz-xxd13-build session scratchpad anat/d.pkl, scripts an1-3.py):
- The function set is fixed (~550, none new after window 4 of 10,000 completions). Only keys per function grow: 0.10-0.14 new keys per completion, no saturation. A key runs 3.0 times on average; the highest ReturnType revision is 17. There is no climbing fact cycle; re-runs follow from new caller keys.
- Keys by function: Stream.compose/2#lambda@0/2 2,221; Enum.reduce/3#lambda@0/2 950; List.reduce/3 172; Range.reduce/5 154; Map.reduce/4 154; each Enumerable.*.reduce/3 ~126. Enumerable.Range.reduce/3 holds the same 126 (acc, reducer) pairs as Enumerable.Map.reduce/3 although the program never uses a Range.
- The keys are a subset of a product of early-saturating columns: compose lambda (funs 2, reducer 49, entry 4, acc 20) = 7,840 possible, 2,221 seen.

Two doors into that product, both verified:
1. fz-sc8.127's rule: visit_protocol_callback (jobs/keying.rs) keys a callback's non-receiver arguments Whole, and a receiver typed any reaches every implementation. Enumerable.Stream.reduce wraps the reducer in Stream.compose and dispatches on any again.
2. A closure literal carries its own specialization in its arrow surface (specialize_surface, types/sigs.rs; kept apart on purpose by the fz-kdt.106 tests). Two surfaces over one literal are equivalent types with two ids, so every function the closure passes through is keyed once per surface: 1,605 of 7,038 AnalyzeActivation keys on the distiller, 53 of 1,030 on variant R4. A spike that forces the canonical surface at intern (anat/surface_spike.patch; 28 lib tests fail, so it is evidence, not a fix) takes anat/min.fz from 24,041 to 17,065 completions and 41.9 s to 20.0 s user CPU.

Not the cause: self-nested closures (none in any key; fz-sc8.117 holds), fz-y5x's cont<->step rungs (present, bounded by the acc set), fz-sc8.143 literals (minor).

Repro: anat/min.fz (~65 lines, ~23 s CPU without telemetry); anat/min_plus_site.exs adds one 7-line reduce site with a list accumulator and passes 149 s CPU.

Owner of the key question: the OptionParser session builds fz-sc8.127 (proposal first) with min.fz and min_plus_site.exs as acceptance programs; both doors go into its hand answer. This ticket closes when the distiller's compile finishes inside the default budget.
title: The distiller's compile finishes
